# Whit Fitness

> Whit Fitness (formerly CrossFit Evviva) is a coached CrossFit and HYROX gym at 277 Blair Blvd, Eugene, OR 97402, in the Whiteaker neighborhood of Eugene, Oregon. It also runs Vitality, a strength and balance class for adults 55+, hosts ATP youth athletic training, and offers one-to-one personal training and open gym with 24/7 member access. Slogan: "Train Smarter." Rated 5.0 on Google across 70 reviews.

Phone/text: (458) 234-3673 · Email: contact.crossfitevviva@gmail.com · Map: https://maps.google.com/?cid=10535944655785304145
Hours: Mon–Thu 5:00am–7:30pm · Fri 5:00am–6:30pm · Sat 8:00–11:00am · Sun 8:30am–1:00pm · members 24/7 by keycode
Book a class: https://crossfitevviva.wodify.com/OnlineSalesPage/Main?q=Classes%7CLocationId%3D656

## Programs
- [CrossFit classes](https://whit-fitness.com/crossfit): coached 60-minute classes, scaled for all levels, weekdays from 5am
- [HYROX training](https://whit-fitness.com/hyrox): running, sleds, SkiErg, rowing and wall balls; first class free
- [Vitality 55+](https://whit-fitness.com/vitality): low-impact strength, balance and cardio for adults 55+, Tue/Thu 10am
- [ATP youth training](https://whit-fitness.com/youth): ATP (Advanced Training & Performance, formerly atpeugene.com) strength and athletic development for middle and high school athletes; personal, small group and team training
- [Personal training](https://whit-fitness.com/personal-training): one-to-one coaching with a free consult
